type RequestIdentity struct
  Key string
  HistoryEpoch string
  Attempt int64
type Submission struct
  Identity RequestIdentity
  Kind string
  Spec []byte
  RequiredGuarantees []string
  Label string
type Receipt struct
  Identity RequestIdentity
  LogicalOwner string
  OperationID string
  AcceptedGuarantees []string
  HistoryRetentionMs int64
type AcceptanceResult struct
  Outcome AcceptanceOutcome
  Receipt *Receipt
  Reason string
type HistoryWindow struct
  LogicalOwner string
  HistoryEpoch string
  MinimumRetentionMs int64
  ResultRetentionMs int64
type CancellationResult struct
  Outcome CancellationOutcome
type WorkProgress struct
  Done int64
  Total int64
type WorkFailure struct
  Classification FailureClass
  Message string
  Cause FailureCause
type OperationSnapshot struct
  Receipt Receipt
  State WorkState
  Progress WorkProgress
  CancellationRequested bool
  Failure *WorkFailure
  Label string
  LabelDerived bool
  Waiting string
type ObservationResult struct
  Outcome ObservationOutcome
  Snapshot *OperationSnapshot
type ResultChunk struct
  Receipt Receipt
  Offset int64
  Total int64
  Data []byte
  EOF bool
type ResultRead struct
  Outcome ResultOutcome
  Chunk *ResultChunk
type ResultLink struct
  Outcome LinkOutcome
  Receipt *Receipt
  Size int64
type WorkObservation struct
  Outcome WorkObservationOutcome
  Next string
  Snapshot *OperationSnapshot
  Mechanism WorkObservationMechanism
type InventoryPage struct
  Outcome InventoryOutcome
  Snapshots []OperationSnapshot
  Next string
  Complete bool
type OperatorCancellation struct
  Outcome OperatorCancellationOutcome
type EndpointRefusalDetail struct
  Source EndpointRefusalSource
  Decision EndpointRefusalDecision
  Ask EndpointRefusalAsk
  Action string
  Question string
  Credential string
  RetryAfterMs int64
type EndpointProducerCheck struct
  Kind string
  Copy string
  State EndpointProducerCheckState
  Reason string
  Checked string
type EndpointServiceState struct
  Service string
  Readiness EndpointServiceReadiness
  Reason string
  Guarantees []string
  Capabilities map[string]string
  DefinitionHash string
type EndpointDescription struct
  Outcome EndpointDescriptionOutcome
  Program string
  Version string
  Services []EndpointServiceState
  Refusal *EndpointRefusalDetail
  Reason string
  Checks []EndpointProducerCheck
type EndpointDescriptionResult struct
  Value EndpointDescription
